Bakerloo.reason: Bakerloo Line: Severe delays between Queen's Park and Elephant & Castle due to an operational incident. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line. Tickets will be accepted on London buses, Lioness line, London Northwestern Railway and Thameslink services.

Elizabeth line.reason: ELIZABETH LINE: Monday 29 June, Tuesday 30 and Wednesday 1 July, after 2200 each evening, a reduced service operates between Paddington and Heathrow Terminal 4 / Maidenhead. Two trains an hour serve Heathrow Terminal 4, West Drayton, Langley, Slough, Burnham and Maidenhead. Four trains an hour serve Heathrow Terminals 2 and 3. Six trains an hour serve Ealing Broadway, Southall and Hayes & Harlington. After 2300, trains will not call at Acton Main Line, West Ealing and Hanwell.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: Severe delays between Harrow-on-the-Hill and Uxbridge due to an earlier fire alert at Ruislip. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line. Ticket are being accepted on London Buses.

Mildmay.reason: MILDMAY LINE: Monday 29, Tuesday 30 June, Wednesday 1 and Thursday 2 July, the 2203 and 2234 trains from Clapham Junction terminate at Willesden Junction instead of Stratford.

Piccadilly.reason: Piccadilly Line: Severe delays between Acton Town and Heathrow Airport/Uxbridge due to an earlier person ill on a train at Turnpike Lane and a fire alert at Ruislip. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses and Elizabeth line services via any reasonable route. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.
